matched_destination.compound_arithmetic: Both native branches retain GMM2, BF16 epilogue, original producer barriers and ordered FP32 weighted unpermute. Cases use true format29 synthetic weights and archived physical routes. The measured destination alternatives reduce an independently seeded bank with the exact slot values; they do not deliver new answers for changing requests.
notes: Per-round sum of independent layer events, after taking maximum rank duration for each local launch. Only matched writer destination is changed between modes 1/2/3. Flanking controls and mode 0 read the native slot bank.

Traffic-weighted scenarios assume linear exposed time per logical inter-card or sibling vector and unchanged computation/overlap. One-hop scenario neglects its possible extra sibling transfers. These scenarios exclude reducer load distribution, final-result dependencies, required notifications and changed consumer scheduling; they are not upper bounds or measured alternative placements.
V1 is selected for M*6>4096 and V2 otherwise by installed source. One selected route census; actual full-model C8 latency and layer-to-request exposure remain open.

contract.applicability: Only original CombineV1, INT8 activation, EP16, 48 vector cores, 24 experts per rank, top6, H5120, width 4608 and M<=834. V1 selects M*6>4096. Stock V2 retained. Uses existing caller, storage and barriers, no diagnostics ABI in production image or operator.
contract.intervention: For every expert and destination split already-clipped dataRows into three disjoint contiguous subranges. Shift gmC2, dequant scale and destination row together. The same per-row BF16 casts, final unpermute, synchronization and tensor ownership remain in effect.
contract.cases: All 160 previously stored natural 40-layer calls, original/candidate/original independently compiled kernel arms, 12 max-rank full operator events per call per arm. Identical real NZ weights formats, synthetic values and actual route IDs; compare every output and expert count across arms.
contract.gate: Predeclare one adoption decision over the 120 natural V1 cases. Median round sum >=1% lower than both flanking controls, at least 9/12 round sums below each, and each individual V1 carrier median lower than both. Keep separate M416 V2 control: no >2% slowdown against both references simultaneously. Complete correctness and deployment binary evidence required. A natural C8 service trial then evaluates actual shape mix including zero-hit rounds, separately for P90 TTFT and makespan. No reruns for a favorable sample.
contract.scheduling: 1<=n<=834*6 relevant sender rows; exhaustive clipped ranges and real segment histogram before service timed tests. No new buffers or remote final hop.

deployable_native.scope: Same topology, NZ29 geometry and actual physical routes. Candidate writes true outputs directly to the original remote slots. Stock and candidate share the same host/API and source endpoints. Event sums are separate native calls and cannot establish service speed.

limits: Same-profile configuration and shape-count host observer in every arm; no profiler windows or tensor copies. CPU admission, carrier mix, cache allocation and overlap may vary across process generations. Natural shapes retained as observed.
Exact complete decoded texts and token lengths at fixed prompts. Internal native bitwise checks used archived routes and synthetic weights. Neither gives all-input numerical equivalence.
